label: Shared Andalusian Aristotelian tradition harmonizing faith and reason
description: Moses Maimonides (Rambam) was fundamentally influenced by Ibn Rushd (Averroes)'s central inquiries, which shaped the evolution of their philosophical worldview.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Ibn Rushd (Averroes)'s perspective to Moses Maimonides (Rambam)'s reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Direct contemporaneous dialogue and pedagogical transmission during the Medieval & Islamic Golden Age era.
